name: Ombre Perfumed Body Mist - Golden Hour - 120ml
description:
Capture the pure essence of twilight, wrapping you in a golden embrace. An Amber Floral Fragrance, blending Pear, Mandarin and Cinnamon with a rich base of Vanilla and Coffee. Spray the mist directly on your skin focusing on the nerve points like wrists and neck.

All-day protection against sweat odor
Long-lasting fragrance
Quick absorption, non-greasy
Inspired by Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium
